resource.title: [Jules Task 12] Multi-Chassis Excel Interactive Matrix & Formula Suite
resource.prompt:
Create a comprehensive unit test suite in tests/test_excel_interactive_matrix.js for Excel workbook export under scripts/lib/generate_boq_xlsx.js:
1. Test multi-chassis combined quote generation (e.g., 5x ProLiant Gen12 + 2x StoreEver MSL3040 + 1x Alletra Storage in a single multi-sheet workbook).
2. Validate cell formula calculations (SUM, subtotal rows, price totals) and verify zero formula syntax errors.
3. Validate conditional formatting rules: ensure Discontinued SKUs have warning fills and Active SKUs have clean standard styling.
4. Ensure all tests pass and integrate into npm run test:all.
